full_resume:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
MBA graduate with 3-5 years of experience supporting business analysis in operations. Skilled in stakeholder management, requirements gathering, and process mapping. Proficient in SQL and Power BI for data analysis and dashboard creation, contributing to improved reporting accuracy. Experienced in coordinating cross-functional teams and standardizing documentation to support consulting projects. Prepared to apply analytical and communication skills in a UK consulting environment.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Business Analyst Support
- Collaborated with stakeholders to gather and document business requirements, enhancing clarity and alignment for operational reporting and process mapping initiatives.
- Developed and refined operational reports by querying data using SQL and creating visual dashboards in Power BI, improving reporting accuracy.
- Coordinated communication between cross-functional teams and stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of process documentation and reporting outputs.

TECHNICAL SKILLS & TOOLS
Technical Skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI
Business & Analytical Tools: PowerPoint, Jira
Transferable & Soft Skills: Stakeholder Management, Communication, Process Mapping, Documentation, Problem Solving

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS
MBA in Operations and Finance
Business Analysis Foundation Certificate

PROJECTS
Reporting Dashboard and Documentation Standardization Initiative
- Designed and implemented a reporting dashboard using Power BI to visualize key operational metrics, improving data accessibility for stakeholders.
- Standardized documentation templates and processes to enhance consistency and efficiency in business requirement gathering and reporting.

LEADERSHIP EXPERIENCE
- Mentored junior analysts by providing guidance on data analysis techniques and reporting best practices, fostering skill development within the team.
- Led coordination of review meetings to facilitate stakeholder feedback and ensure alignment on project deliverables.
strengths: Collaborated with stakeholders to gather and document business requirements, enhancing clarity and alignment for operational reporting and process mapping initiatives.
Developed and refined operational reports by querying data using SQL and creating visual dashboards in Power BI to improve reporting accuracy.
Enhanced reporting clarity and streamlined documentation processes to support operational decision-making.
